newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-F1 BOSS WALKINSHAW ENTERS RUGBY FAST LANE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-F1 BOSS WALKINSHAW ENTERS RUGBY FAST LANE.

text.p: Tom Walkinshaw, boss of the Arrows Formula One team, moved into the fast lane of English club rugby on Tuesday.
He confirmed he was planning a long-term investment in first division Gloucester who signed former French captain Philippe Saint-Andre earlier this month.
Walkinshaw, who recruited F1 world champion Damon Hill this season, would not say how much money he planned to pump into the club but said his aim was to take Gloucester "right to the top".
